extDescription.message: Hands downloads and videos to the dm app, which downloads them. With no app, the browser keeps them.
extDescription.description: The extension's description; the stores take 132 characters at most.

menuLink.description: The menu item on a link.

menuMedia.description: The menu item on a video or audio element.

menuAllLinks.description: The menu item on a page.

menuSelectedLinks.description: The menu item on a selection.

popupLooking.description: The status line while the app is asked how it is.

popupCatch.description: The switch that catches downloads at all.

popupPanelHere.description: The panel's switch before the site is known.

popupPanelOn.description: The panel's switch for a site.

popupPanelNone.message: No video panel on this page
popupPanelNone.description: The panel's switch on a page that is not a site.

popupCatchAllHere.message: Take every download from this site
popupCatchAllHere.description: The take-everything switch before the site is known.

popupCatchAllOn.description: The take-everything switch for a site.

popupCatchAllNone.message: No downloads to take from this page
popupCatchAllNone.description: The take-everything switch on a page that is not a site.

popupPausedHere.description: The pause switch before the site is known.

popupPausedOn.description: The pause switch for a site.

popupPausedNone.message: No downloads to pause on this page
popupPausedNone.description: The pause switch on a page that is not a site.

popupCookiesHere.message: Hand over this site's sign-in with its downloads
popupCookiesHere.description: The sign-in switch before the site is known.

popupCookiesOn.message: Hand over $SITE$'s sign-in with its downloads
popupCookiesOn.description: The sign-in switch for a site.

popupCookiesNone.message: No sign-in to hand over from this page
popupCookiesNone.description: The sign-in switch on a page that is not a site.

popupOpen.description: The button that brings the app up.

popupGetApp.description: The link to the app's download page, with no app to open.

popupNoAnswer.message: The dm app did not answer
popupNoAnswer.description: The status line when the app gave no answer and nothing said why.

popupConnected.description: The status line for an app that answered.

popupConnectedOld.message: Connected to dm $VERSION$ · update the dm app: until then the browser keeps its downloads
popupConnectedOld.description: The status line for an app too old to judge pages.

popupWider.message: That was set for all of $SITES$, so it is changed there too
popupWider.description: A switch turned off on part of a site listed whole.

popupAnd.description: Two sites, or a list and one more, said together.

popupNotConnected.message: dm isn't connected to this browser yet. No dm app on this computer yet? click Get the dm app below, install it and open it once. Already installed: open dm once (if it's already open, open it again) so it can connect, then reopen this popup. Advanced: $COMMAND$
popupNotConnected.description: The status line when the browser finds no dm to talk to.

popupNotAnswering.message: dm did not answer ($REASON$). Open dm (if it's already open, open it again), then reopen this popup. If it still does not answer: $COMMAND$
popupNotAnswering.description: The status line when dm is there and did not answer.

panelDownloadVideo.description: The bar over a video, and its list's heading.

panelDownloadAudio.description: The bar over an audio player.

panelProtected.description: The bar over a copy-protected player.

panelProtectedSaid.message: This video is copy-protected, so only the site's own player can play it. dm does not download protected video.
panelProtectedSaid.description: What a click on a copy-protected player's bar says.

panelThroughApp.message: this page, through the dm app
panelThroughApp.description: Where a player page's video comes from, on hover.

panelHelp.message: dm downloads this video with the dm app, where you choose its name and folder. A link clicked with the keep key held (Alt unless changed in dm's Options) stays in the browser.

panelThisSite.description: The site, where the page's address names none.

panelReading.description: The bar while the app reads the video's qualities.

panelReadingSaid.message: dm is reading this page's video qualities; this can take up to half a minute.
panelReadingSaid.description: The line under it, so a wait is not taken for a hang.

panelTimedOut.message: dm did not answer in time. Try again, or right-click the video and choose Download media with dm.
panelTimedOut.description: The app gave no list of qualities in time.

panelSending.description: The bar while the choice is handed to the app.

panelNotTaken.description: The bar when the app refused it.

panelUpdated.message: dm was updated: reload this page to use it
panelUpdated.description: The page's script is older than the extension it talks to.

panelSent.description: The bar when the app took it.

panelInBrowser.description: The bar when the browser is downloading it instead.

panelDownloadAll.description: The list's first line: every quality at once.

panelPart.description: The list's "Part" line, before its start.

panelPartStart.description: The name of the part's start box.

panelPartEnd.description: The name of the part's end box.

panelFileQuality.description: A quality line for a height the player named: "MP4 file, quality 1080p HD".

panelAppReading.message: the dm app is reading this page for its video
panelAppReading.description: The background's answer for a page handed to the app to read.

panelAppHas.description: The background's answer for a hand-off the app asks about first.

panelAppDownloading.message: the dm app is downloading it
panelAppDownloading.description: The background's answer for a hand-off the app started.

panelNoAnswer.description: The plain panel: the app gave no answer to the list of qualities.

panelFailed.message: dm did not answer. Try again, or right-click the video and choose Download media with dm.
panelFailed.description: The plain panel: asking for the list failed.

panelHls.description: The plain panel's line for the HLS playlist the page's own player names.

panelDownload.description: The plain panel's line for a choice that names nothing.
